final:
I changed `validate_metadata` in `pandas/io/pytables.py` so that appending float categories to integer categories raises the "cannot append a categorical with different categories" `ValueError` again. I haven't run it or any tests, since I can't build or run anything here.

The check passed `dtype_equal=True` to `array_equivalent` without first confirming the dtypes matched. With int categories on one side and float on the other, that sent mismatched arrays into the low-level comparison, which caused the buffer type error. The check now treats a dtype difference as a categories mismatch before calling `array_equivalent`.

I didn't add a test for the int-then-float append case.
